# Bolt Fusion Tech

> We engineer intelligent software, business systems, automation, and connected technologies — from idea to production.

Bolt Fusion Tech is a senior engineering team working across the UK, Malaysia and
Bangladesh. Software. Intelligence. Automation. Machines.

## What we engineer

Six capabilities, each labelled with its evidence. Proven: shipped, with a case
study or project. Core: repeated work. Capable: we can engineer it; no delivery
yet. Lab: research or prototype only.

- Software engineering (Proven): web platforms, mobile applications (React
  Native), backend systems (NestJS, Django), APIs and integrations (REST,
  GraphQL, gRPC), real-time platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS on Postgres
  row-level security. Shipped: Go Style Business, Balanzify, FanLock, Delivery
  Lens BD and Sudarshini, and feature work for Bazzile and GodConnect.
- AI & automation (Proven): AI agents with a human hand-off, LLM applications,
  retrieval and search, intelligent workflows, and AI services built to plug
  into a larger product. Document intelligence is Capable. Shipped: WarmChats
  and the restaurant search.
- ERP & enterprise systems: HR, payroll and a wholesale back office are Proven
  (Balanzify's microservices, TTouch Clothing's employee verification and
  TTouch Wholesale's quotations, sales memos, supplier stock and accounts).
  Full ERP is Capable: designed in our point-of-sale back-office plans, not yet
  delivered.
- POS & commerce: point of sale is Core — we've built point-of-sale systems for
  restaurants, including offline sync and receipt-printer integration, and
  we're building a multi-tenant platform for retail and other verticals.
  Online and wholesale commerce are Proven: the Sudarshini store and TTouch
  Clothing's wholesale portal. No payments or commerce integrations are
  claimed.
- Robotics & intelligent systems (Lab): we engineer software for machines; we
  don't manufacture hardware. We haven't delivered robotics work yet, and
  nothing here is a shipped system.
- Cloud, data & infrastructure (Core): cloud deployment (Vercel), PostgreSQL
  and Redis, Docker and Docker Swarm, CI/CD on GitHub Actions, metrics and
  structured logging, row-level security and JWT.

How we work: named engineers assigned before you sign, 4–8 hours of overlap with US
and EU working days, IP assigned on payment, and an NDA before scoping. Your first
call is with the engineer who writes the code.

Most engagements start with a two-week paid pilot: a scoped slice of your real
product, fixed price, full IP, no obligation.

Every figure published on this site carries a `shipped` or `target` label.

  Then the system map: how the six fit together.
- [Industries](/industries): each industry's problems and what we would build
  for it. Delivered work is linked only where it exists: restaurants (the
  restaurant search, and our point-of-sale work), retail (Sudarshini and TTouch
  Wholesale, built for TTouch Clothing, and OPAL, our own store; retail point
  of sale in development), real estate (WarmChats, and feature work for
  Bazzile), HR (Balanzify, and TTouch Clothing's employee verification), salons

  Clothing). Healthcare, education, enterprise operations and startups are

  by layer; architecture principles from the systems we built, each linked to

- [About](/about): who we are; the team, 15+ developers; where our engineers
  work (the UK, Malaysia and Bangladesh); how we
  work with clients: engagement models, the two-week pilot, IP and NDA; and what
  we won't do.
- [Insights](/insights): technical articles written from real work, by Bolt
  Fusion Tech engineering. Every figure in them is labelled.
  - [Routing AI so most queries never reach a model](/insights/routing-ai-so-most-queries-never-reach-a-model)
  - [Offline-first point of sale: keeping the till selling when the network drops](/insights/offline-first-point-of-sale)
  - [Multi-tenant SaaS on Postgres row-level security](/insights/multi-tenant-saas-on-postgres-row-level-security)
- [Contact](/contact): schedule a call on the booking calendar, email the team,
  or send a short project brief by email.
- [Intelligent restaurant search](/work/restaurant-search): multi-tenant AI
  retrieval. Queries are classified before any paid inference runs; most traffic
  resolves on a sub-100ms path (`shipped`), and the architecture caps average
  model spend at roughly $0.001 per AI-assisted query (`target`: a budget the
  design holds to, not a measurement).
- [WarmChats](/work/warmchats): always-on AI follow-up for real estate agents,
  built by Bolt Fusion for WarmChats, Inc., which owns the product.
  Claude qualifies and routes each lead, GPT-4.1 replies on email and SMS, and
  bookings write to the calendar. First-reply-under-60s is a `target`.
- [All work](/work): the two case studies, the other products we built —
  among them TTouch Clothing's four systems, at /work#ttouch-clothing — and our
  engineers' track record, every card labelled with who built it.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy)

## Who built what

Every project on /work carries one of five labels. Credit each one as labelled.

Case studies, built by Bolt Fusion, each with a write-up on this site:

- WarmChats: built by Bolt Fusion for WarmChats, Inc., which owns the product.
  Our role: backend lead. Live at https://www.warmchats.com/
- Intelligent restaurant search: built by Bolt Fusion, the multi-tenant
  restaurant discovery microservice.

Bolt Fusion projects, delivered by Bolt Fusion. Where a company is named, the
product is theirs, not ours:

- FanLock (https://fanlock-pi.vercel.app/): a content-protection platform for
  online creators. Built by Bolt Fusion; our role: backend lead. Live.
- Balanzify (https://balanzify.com/): an HR and payroll platform built as NestJS
  microservices. Built by Bolt Fusion for Balanzify Inc., which owns it. In
  production, Jul 2025 – ongoing.
- Go Style Business (https://business.gostyle.uk/): a salon business management
  platform. Built by Bolt Fusion; our role: backend lead. In production.

TTouch Clothing's four systems. TTouch Clothing, a fashion brand from
Bangladesh, owns all four; Bolt Fusion built each end to end — design, app,
backend and database — as an outside vendor:

- Delivery Lens BD (https://deliverylensbd.com/): a subscription web app for
  online sellers in Bangladesh that checks a customer's delivery record across
  several couriers and rates the risk before the order ships, with bulk checks
  and a developer API. Built by Bolt Fusion for TTouch Clothing. Live.
- TTouch Wholesale (https://wholesale.ttouch.clothing/): an approval-based
  wholesale portal, with a back office for quotations, sales memos, supplier
  stock and accounts, and the pricing rules. Built by Bolt Fusion for TTouch
  Clothing. Live.
- Sudarshini (https://sudarshini.com/): the online store of Sudarshini,
  TTouch Clothing's saree brand, with shoppable product videos,
  cash-on-delivery checkout and an admin. Built by Bolt Fusion for TTouch
  Clothing. Live.
- TTouch Employee Verification (https://employee.ttouch.clothing/): a public
  page that confirms a person works at TTouch Clothing, and an HR back office
  for staff records and departments with an audit log. Built by Bolt Fusion
  for TTouch Clothing. Live.

Feature work, delivered by Bolt Fusion inside apps other companies own. We
built features in these apps, not the apps: each app belongs to the company
named, and is not Bolt Fusion's product.

- Bazzile (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/bazzile/id1622224603;
  Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bazzile.app):
  a Swiss real-estate marketplace app based in Geneva. Features built by Bolt
  Fusion for Bazzile Technology SA, which owns the app: swipe-based browsing,
  Google Maps location matching and Firebase real-time sync in its React
  Native app. Live. Jan 2025 – Jul 2025.
- GodConnect Online (App Store:
  https://apps.apple.com/us/app/godconnect-online/id1518393186; Google Play:
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.godconnect.online): a
  community app with groups, live broadcasts, messaging, media uploads and a
  GPS-based church finder. Features built by Bolt Fusion for GodConnect LTD,
  which owns the app: feature work in its React Native app. Live. 2023 – 2024.

In-house, our own product, not built for a client:

- OPAL (https://opal-sooty.vercel.app/): a curated fashion and tech e-commerce
  store. Live.

Our engineers' track record: work our engineers shipped at previous employers.
It is credited to them and to those employers. It is not Bolt Fusion's work,
and the companies involved are not our clients.

- Go Smart: Modhumoti Bank's digital banking app, built at Brain Station 23,
  2020–2022. Our engineer's role: Software Engineer, secure backend services.
